import ast
from collections import Counter
from fractions import Fraction
from .parser import ParseError, parse_output

VERSION = "verifier-v1"

def verify(text, numbers, target):
    r = dict(parse_ok=False, operators_ok=False, numbers_ok=False,
             value=None, target_ok=False, valid=False, error_code=None,
             expression=None)
    if (not isinstance(numbers, list) or not 2 <= len(numbers) <= 6
        or any(type(x) is not int or not 1 <= x <= 999999 for x in numbers)
        or type(target) is not int or not 1 <= target <= 10**9):
        r["error_code"] = "BAD_PROBLEM"
        return r
    try:
        expr, tree = parse_output(text)
    except ParseError as e:
        r.update(parse_ok=e.parse_ok, operators_ok=e.operators_ok, error_code=e.code)
        return r
    r.update(parse_ok=True, operators_ok=True, expression=expr)
    used = [n.value for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, ast.Constant)]
    if Counter(used) != Counter(numbers):
        r["error_code"] = "NUMBERS"
        return r
    r["numbers_ok"] = True
    def compute(n):
        if isinstance(n, ast.Expression):
            return compute(n.body)
        if isinstance(n, ast.Constant):
            return Fraction(n.value)
        if isinstance(n, ast.UnaryOp):
            return -compute(n.operand)
        a, b = compute(n.left), compute(n.right)
        if isinstance(n.op, ast.Add): v = a + b
        elif isinstance(n.op, ast.Sub): v = a - b
        elif isinstance(n.op, ast.Mult): v = a * b
        else: v = a / b
        if v.numerator.bit_length() > 128 or v.denominator.bit_length() > 128:
            raise OverflowError
        return v
    try:
        value = compute(tree)
    except ZeroDivisionError:
        r["error_code"] = "DIV_ZERO"
        return r
    except (OverflowError, RecursionError):
        r["error_code"] = "VALUE_LIMIT"
        return r
    r.update(value=str(value), valid=True, target_ok=value == Fraction(target))
    r["error_code"] = None if r["target_ok"] else "WRONG_TARGET"
    return r

def build_prompt(row, style="direct"):
    if style not in {"direct", "fewshot"}: raise ValueError(style)
    rule = ("Use every supplied positive integer exactly once (including repeats). "
            "Allowed: + - * /, parentheses, unary minus; exact rational arithmetic. "
            "No other numbers, functions, or zero division. End with exactly one line "
            "FINAL: expression. Do not write anything after it.")
    messages = [{"role":"system","content":rule}]
    if style == "fewshot":
        # Ví dụ riêng, chỉ 3 số: không trùng bài ID 4 số hoặc OOD 5 số.
        messages += [{"role":"user","content":"Numbers: [1, 2, 3]; target: 7"},
                     {"role":"assistant","content":"FINAL: 1 + 2 * 3"},
                     {"role":"user","content":"Numbers: [2, 4, 6]; target: 1"},
                     {"role":"assistant","content":"FINAL: (6 - 4) / 2"}]
    messages.append({"role":"user","content":f"Numbers: {row['numbers']}; target: {row['target']}"})
    return messages

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import time
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from .generator import read_jsonl, assert_dataset_valid
from .prompts import build_prompt
from .verifier import verify, VERSION

def select(pool, method):
    valid = [r for r in pool if r["verifier"]["valid"]]
    if method == "B3":
        correct = [r for r in valid if r["verifier"]["target_ok"]]
        return (correct or valid or pool)[0]
    if method != "B2": raise ValueError(method)
    if not valid: return pool[0]
    counts = Counter(r["verifier"]["value"] for r in valid)
    best = max(counts.values())
    # Thứ tự pool cố định: tie-break sample xuất hiện đầu tiên.
    return next(r for r in valid if counts[r["verifier"]["value"]] == best)

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--dataset",required=True);p.add_argument("--out",required=True)
    p.add_argument("--model",default="Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct")
    p.add_argument("--revision",required=True,help="40-character model commit SHA")
    p.add_argument("--adapter");p.add_argument("--style",choices=["direct","fewshot"],default="direct")
    p.add_argument("--n",type=int,default=1);p.add_argument("--max-new-tokens",type=int,default=128)
    p.add_argument("--temperature",type=float,default=.8);p.add_argument("--top-p",type=float,default=.95)
    p.add_argument("--seed",type=int,default=42);p.add_argument("--config-id",required=True)
    p.add_argument("--sample",action="store_true",help="sample even if N=1; N>1 always samples")
    a=p.parse_args()
    if a.n < 1 or a.max_new_tokens < 1: raise ValueError("Positive N/length required")
    if len(a.revision)!=40 or any(c not in '0123456789abcdef' for c in a.revision):
        raise ValueError("Pin exact model/tokenizer commit, not main")
    out=Path(a.out);paths=[out,Path(str(out)+".manifest.json")]
    if a.n>1: paths += [Path(str(out)+f".{m}.selected.jsonl") for m in ("B2","B3")]
    if any(x.exists() for x in paths): raise FileExistsError("Use a fresh log path")
    rows=read_jsonl(a.dataset);assert_dataset_valid(rows)
    import torch
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
    from peft import PeftModel
    device="cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    dtype=torch.float32 if device=="cpu" else (torch.bfloat16 if torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported() else torch.float16)
    tokenizer=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(a.model,revision=a.revision)
    tokenizer.pad_token=tokenizer.eos_token
    model=AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(a.model,revision=a.revision,torch_dtype=dtype)
    if a.adapter: model=PeftModel.from_pretrained(model,a.adapter)
    model.to(device);model.eval()
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    manifest=vars(a)|dict(device=device,dtype=str(dtype),verifier_version=VERSION,
        dataset_sha256=hashlib.sha256(Path(a.dataset).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        timing="generate wall-time with GPU synchronization; excludes loading/tokenization",
        output_token_count="includes generated EOS; input tokens logged separately")
    Path(str(out)+".manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
    selected={m:[] for m in ("B2","B3")}
    with out.open("x",encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for idx,row in enumerate(rows):
            prompt=tokenizer.apply_chat_template(build_prompt(row,a.style),tokenize=False,add_generation_prompt=True)
            inputs=tokenizer(prompt,return_tensors="pt",add_special_tokens=False).to(device)
            pool=[]
            for j in range(a.n):
                seed=a.seed+idx*a.n+j;torch.manual_seed(seed)
                if device=="cuda": torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed);torch.cuda.synchronize()
                sampled=a.sample or a.n>1
                options=dict(max_new_tokens=a.max_new_tokens,do_sample=sampled,pad_token_id=tokenizer.pad_token_id)
                if sampled: options.update(temperature=a.temperature,top_p=a.top_p)
                start=time.perf_counter()
                with torch.inference_mode(): result=model.generate(**inputs,**options)
                if device=="cuda": torch.cuda.synchronize()
                seconds=time.perf_counter()-start
                generated=result[0,inputs.input_ids.shape[1]:]
                text=tokenizer.decode(generated,skip_special_tokens=True)
                v=verify(text,row["numbers"],row["target"])
                rec=dict(problem_id=row["id"],split=row["split"],sample_index=j,seed=seed,
                    prompt_hash=hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest(),output=text,expression=v["expression"],
                    verifier=v,error_code=v["error_code"],tokens=len(generated),seconds=seconds,
                    input_tokens=inputs.input_ids.shape[1],method=("B0" if a.style=="direct" else "B1") if a.n==1 else "POOL",
                    config_id=a.config_id)
                f.write(json.dumps(rec,ensure_ascii=False)+"\n");f.flush();pool.append(rec)
            if a.n>1:
                for method in selected:
                    chosen=select(pool,method)
                    selected[method].append(chosen|dict(method=method,sample_index=0,chosen_sample_index=chosen["sample_index"],
                        selection_budget=a.n,tokens=sum(r["tokens"] for r in pool),seconds=sum(r["seconds"] for r in pool),
                        input_tokens=sum(r["input_tokens"] for r in pool),config_id=a.config_id+"-"+method))
    if a.n>1:
        for method,data in selected.items():
            Path(str(out)+f".{method}.selected.jsonl").write_text("".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in data),encoding="utf-8")
if __name__ == "__main__": main()

("FINAL: 1e1+3+7+2",[2,3,7,10],22,False,False,"TOKEN"),
("FINAL: 0xA+3+7+2",[2,3,7,10],22,False,False,"TOKEN"),
("FINAL: 10.0+3+7+2",[2,3,7,10],22,False,False,"TOKEN"),
("FINAL: True+3+7+2",[1,2,3,7],13,False,False,"TOKEN"),
("FINAL: 10+3+7+2\nThanks",[2,3,7,10],22,False,False,"FINAL_LINE"),
("FINAL: 10//3+7+2",[2,3,7,10],12,False,False,"OPERATOR"),
("FINAL: (10+3+7+2",[2,3,7,10],22,False,False,"SYNTAX"),
("FINAL: 1000000+3+7+2",[2,3,7,10],22,False,False,"LITERAL_LIMIT"),
])
def test_contract(text,numbers,target,valid,correct,error):
    r=verify(text,numbers,target)
    assert (r["valid"],r["target_ok"],r["error_code"]) == (valid,correct,error)
    assert score(r)==float(valid and correct)
    assert score(r,"shaped")== (1.0 if valid and correct else .1 if valid else 0)

def test_bad_problem():
    assert verify("FINAL: 1+2",[True,2],3)["error_code"]=="BAD_PROBLEM"

def test_bad_reward_mode():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): score({},"unknown")

import copy
import pytest
from src.generator import generate, assert_dataset_valid, canonical_key, build, read_jsonl
from src.eval import evaluate, pass_k
from src.verifier import verify
from src.baseline import select

@pytest.mark.parametrize("profile",["id","ood-range","ood-arity","ood-fraction","ood-depth"])
def test_generator(profile):

    assert len(assert_dataset_valid(rows))==12
    assert rows==generate(12,42,"expression",profile)

def test_solver():
    assert len(assert_dataset_valid(generate(3,7,"solver","id")))==3

def test_split_freeze(tmp_path):
    build(tmp_path,40,42,"expression","id",[])
    paths=[tmp_path/f"{s}.jsonl" for s in ("train","validation","test-id")]
    rows=[r for p in paths for r in read_jsonl(p)]
    assert len(assert_dataset_valid(rows))==40
    with pytest.raises(FileExistsError): build(tmp_path,40,42,"expression","id",[])
    build(tmp_path,5,43,"expression","ood-fraction",paths)
    ood=read_jsonl(tmp_path/"ood-fraction.jsonl")
    assert not (assert_dataset_valid(rows)&assert_dataset_valid(ood))

def test_duplicate():
    rows=generate(1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): assert_dataset_valid(rows+rows)
    assert canonical_key([2,3,7,10],47)==canonical_key([10,7,3,2],47)

def fixture():
    row=dict(id="test-id-000000",numbers=[2,3,7,10],target=47,
        reference_expression="(10-3)*7-2",split="test-id")
    outputs=["FINAL: (10-3)*7-2"]+["FINAL: 2+3+7+10"]*3
    logs=[dict(problem_id=row["id"],split=row["split"],sample_index=i,seed=i,
        output=t,verifier=verify(t,row["numbers"],row["target"]),tokens=10,seconds=.1,
        method="POOL",config_id="t",prompt_hash="x") for i,t in enumerate(outputs)]
    return [row],logs

def test_metric():

    assert r["pass_at_1"]==.25 and r["pass_at_k"]==.5
    assert r["valid_output_rate"]==1
    assert pass_k(4,0,4)==0 and pass_k(4,4,4)==1

def test_vote_not_oracle():
    _,logs=fixture()
    assert select(logs,"B2")["verifier"]["value"]=="22"
    assert select(logs,"B3")["verifier"]["target_ok"]

@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind",["duplicate","missing","mixed","stale","k","gap"])
def test_bad_log(kind):
    data,logs=fixture();k=1
    if kind=="duplicate":logs.append(copy.deepcopy(logs[0]))
    elif kind=="missing":data.append(data[0]|dict(id="missing",numbers=[1,2,3,4],target=10,reference_expression="1+2+3+4"))
    elif kind=="mixed":logs[0]["config_id"]="other"
    elif kind=="stale":logs[0]["verifier"]["value"]="bad"
    elif kind=="k":k=5
    else:logs[0]["sample_index"]=8
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):evaluate(logs,data,expected_n=4,k=k)

def test_uniform_truncation_rejected():
    data,logs=fixture()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):evaluate(logs[:1],data,expected_n=4)

    chosen=logs[0]|dict(method="B3",selection_budget=4)
    result=evaluate([chosen],data,expected_n=1,selection_budget=4)
    assert result["selected_success_rate"]==1
    assert "pass_at_1" not in result
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):evaluate([chosen],data,expected_n=1,selection_budget=8)

import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import platform
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from .generator import read_jsonl, assert_dataset_valid, VERSION as GENERATOR_VERSION
from .verifier import VERSION as VERIFIER_VERSION

EXPECTED={"torch":"2.6.0","transformers":"4.49.0","trl":"0.15.2",
          "peft":"0.14.0","datasets":"3.3.2","accelerate":"1.4.0"}

def prepare(config):
    import torch
    from transformers import set_seed, AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForCausalLM
    for package,wanted in EXPECTED.items():
        actual=importlib.metadata.version(package).split("+")[0]
        if actual != wanted:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{package}: expected {wanted}, got {actual}; use pinned environment")
    if not torch.cuda.is_available(): raise RuntimeError("Training example requires NVIDIA CUDA; core/baseline can use CPU")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}",config["revision"]): raise ValueError("Pin model revision")
    out=Path(config["output_dir"])
    if out.exists(): raise FileExistsError("Fresh output_dir required; never overwrite a run")
    train,val=read_jsonl(config["train"]),read_jsonl(config["validation"])
    # Cả keys lẫn IDs phải độc lập giữa train và validation.
    assert_dataset_valid(train+val)
    if not train or not val: raise ValueError("Empty train/validation")
    if any(r["split"]!="train" for r in train) or any(r["split"]!="validation" for r in val):
        raise ValueError("Expected frozen train and validation files, not test")
    precision=config["precision"]
    if precision not in {"bf16","fp16","fp32"}: raise ValueError(precision)
    if precision=="bf16" and not torch.cuda.is_bf16_supported(): raise RuntimeError("GPU lacks bf16; choose fp16 after smoke test")
    dtype={"bf16":torch.bfloat16,"fp16":torch.float16,"fp32":torch.float32}[precision]
    set_seed(config["seed"])
    tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(config["model"],revision=config["revision"])
    tok.pad_token=tok.eos_token
    model=AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(config["model"],revision=config["revision"],torch_dtype=dtype)
    model.config.use_cache=False
    out.mkdir(parents=True)
    env={p:importlib.metadata.version(p) for p in EXPECTED}
    manifest=dict(config=config,packages=env,python=platform.python_version(),
        gpu=torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),generator_version=GENERATOR_VERSION,verifier_version=VERIFIER_VERSION,
        data_hashes={k:hashlib.sha256(Path(config[k]).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for k in ("train","validation")},
        checkpoint_rule="evaluate saved checkpoints on validation externally; final-adapter is NOT automatically best",
        world_size=1)
    (out/"manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
    return model,tok,train,val,out

def training_args(c):
    return dict(output_dir=c["output_dir"],learning_rate=c["learning_rate"],
        lr_scheduler_type=c["lr_scheduler_type"],warmup_ratio=c["warmup_ratio"],
        max_steps=c["max_steps"],num_train_epochs=c["num_train_epochs"],
        per_device_train_batch_size=c["per_device_train_batch_size"],
        per_device_eval_batch_size=c["per_device_eval_batch_size"],
        gradient_accumulation_steps=c["gradient_accumulation_steps"],
        bf16=c["precision"]=="bf16",fp16=c["precision"]=="fp16",seed=c["seed"],
        gradient_checkpointing=c["gradient_checkpointing"],
        gradient_checkpointing_kwargs={"use_reentrant":False},
        eval_strategy="steps",eval_steps=c["eval_steps"],save_strategy="steps",save_steps=c["save_steps"],
        logging_steps=c["logging_steps"],report_to="none",load_best_model_at_end=False)

def save_run(trainer,tokenizer,out,seconds):
    import torch
    trainer.save_model(str(out/"final-adapter"))
    tokenizer.save_pretrained(out/"final-adapter")
    trainer.save_state()
    data=dict(wall_seconds=seconds,peak_allocated_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),
        peak_reserved_bytes=torch.cuda.max_memory_reserved(),
        warning="Final adapter is last step, not necessarily validation-best")
    (out/"runtime.json").write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")

import argparse
import json
import time
import yaml
import torch
from datasets import Dataset
from peft import LoraConfig, TaskType
from trl import SFTConfig, SFTTrainer
from src.prompts import build_prompt
from src.training_common import prepare,training_args,save_run

class CompletionCollator:
    # Nhãn -100 cho prompt và padding; chỉ học assistant completion.
    def __init__(self,tokenizer): self.tokenizer=tokenizer
    def __call__(self,examples):
        length=max(len(e["input_ids"]) for e in examples)
        batch={"input_ids":[],"attention_mask":[],"labels":[]}
        for e in examples:
            pad=length-len(e["input_ids"])
            batch["input_ids"].append(e["input_ids"]+[self.tokenizer.pad_token_id]*pad)
            batch["attention_mask"].append([1]*len(e["input_ids"])+[0]*pad)
            batch["labels"].append(e["labels"]+[-100]*pad)
        return {k:torch.tensor(v,dtype=torch.long) for k,v in batch.items()}

def encode_rows(rows,tok,c):
    encoded=[]
    for row in rows:
        messages=build_prompt(row,c["prompt_style"])
        prefix=tok.apply_chat_template(messages,tokenize=False,add_generation_prompt=True)
        full=tok.apply_chat_template(messages+[{"role":"assistant","content":"FINAL: "+row["reference_expression"]}],
            tokenize=False,add_generation_prompt=False)
        prefix_ids=tok(prefix,add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"]
        ids=tok(full,add_special_tokens=False)["input_ids"]
        if ids[:len(prefix_ids)] != prefix_ids:
            raise ValueError("Chat token boundary mismatch; inspect tokenizer template")
        if len(ids)>c["max_seq_length"] or len(ids)<=len(prefix_ids):
            raise ValueError("Too long or empty target; do not silently truncate FINAL")
        encoded.append(dict(input_ids=ids,attention_mask=[1]*len(ids),
            labels=[-100]*len(prefix_ids)+ids[len(prefix_ids):]))
    return Dataset.from_list(encoded)

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument("--config",required=True);a=p.parse_args()
    c=yaml.safe_load(open(a.config,encoding="utf-8"))
    model,tok,train,val,out=prepare(c)
    tok.padding_side="right"
    lora=LoraConfig(task_type=TaskType.CAUSAL_LM,bias="none",**c["lora"])
    args=SFTConfig(**training_args(c),max_seq_length=c["max_seq_length"],packing=False,
        dataset_kwargs={"skip_prepare_dataset":True},remove_unused_columns=False)
    trainer=SFTTrainer(model=model,args=args,processing_class=tok,peft_config=lora,
        train_dataset=encode_rows(train,tok,c),eval_dataset=encode_rows(val,tok,c),
        data_collator=CompletionCollator(tok))
    trainer.model.print_trainable_parameters()
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats();start=time.perf_counter()
    try: trainer.train()
    finally:
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        save_run(trainer,tok,out,time.perf_counter()-start)
    print("Evaluate saved checkpoints on validation before selecting final test adapter.")

import argparse
import json
import statistics
import time
import yaml
import torch
from datasets import Dataset
from peft import PeftModel, PeftConfig
from trl import GRPOConfig, GRPOTrainer
from src.prompts import build_prompt
from src.verifier import verify
from src.reward import score
from src.training_common import prepare,training_args,save_run

class AuditedGRPOTrainer(GRPOTrainer):
    # Diagnostic cho TRL 0.15.2 single-GPU; không gọi là entropy token.
    def compute_loss(self,model,inputs,return_outputs=False,num_items_in_batch=None):
        if not hasattr(self,"_guide_diag_step"): self._guide_diag_step=-1
        step=self.state.global_step
        if model.training and self._guide_diag_step != step:
            self._guide_diag_step=step
            with open(self.args.output_dir+"/step-events.jsonl","a",encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(json.dumps(dict(step=step,event="optimization_batch"))+"\n")
        return super().compute_loss(model,inputs,return_outputs=return_outputs,
                                    num_items_in_batch=num_items_in_batch)

def completion_text(completion):
    if isinstance(completion,str): return completion
    if isinstance(completion,list) and len(completion)==1 and isinstance(completion[0],dict):
        content=completion[0].get("content")
        if isinstance(content,str): return content
    raise ValueError("Unexpected completion schema; inspect pinned TRL")

def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument("--config",required=True);a=p.parse_args()
    c=yaml.safe_load(open(a.config,encoding="utf-8"))
    if int(__import__("os").environ.get("WORLD_SIZE","1"))!=1:
        raise ValueError("Educational audit callback supports single GPU only")
    g=c["num_generations"]
    if g<2 or c["per_device_train_batch_size"]%g or c["per_device_eval_batch_size"]%g:
        raise ValueError("TRL 0.15.2 per-device batch must be divisible by G on one GPU")
    if c["reward_mode"] not in {"binary","shaped"}: raise ValueError("Reward mode")
    if c["use_vllm"]: raise ValueError("This smoke script pins use_vllm=False")
    adapter_config=PeftConfig.from_pretrained(c["sft_adapter"])
    if adapter_config.base_model_name_or_path != c["model"]:
        raise ValueError("SFT adapter/base model mismatch")
    model,tok,train,val,out=prepare(c)
    tok.padding_side="left"
    model=PeftModel.from_pretrained(model,c["sft_adapter"],is_trainable=True)
    # KHÔNG truyền peft_config vào trainer: adapter đã tồn tại.
    # Reference của TRL v0.15.2 là model khi disable adapter = original base,
    # không phải snapshot SFT. Báo cáo lựa chọn KL này trong experiment card.
    model.print_trainable_parameters()
    def dataset(rows):
        prepared=[]
        for r in rows:
            prompt=build_prompt(r,c["prompt_style"])
            ids=tok.apply_chat_template(prompt,tokenize=True,add_generation_prompt=True)
            if len(ids)>c["max_prompt_length"]:raise ValueError("Prompt would be truncated")
            prepared.append(dict(prompt=prompt,numbers=r["numbers"],target=r["target"],problem_id=r["id"]))
        return Dataset.from_list(prepared)
    callback_index=0
    def countdown_reward(prompts,completions,numbers,target,problem_id,**kwargs):
        nonlocal callback_index
        if not len(completions)==len(numbers)==len(target)==len(problem_id):
            raise ValueError("Reward callback columns not aligned")
        texts=[completion_text(x) for x in completions]
        results=[verify(t,n,y) for t,n,y in zip(texts,numbers,target)]
        rewards=[score(r,c["reward_mode"]) for r in results]
        if len(rewards)%g:raise ValueError("Incomplete reward groups")
        grouped=[rewards[i:i+g] for i in range(0,len(rewards),g)]
        for i in range(0,len(problem_id),g):
            if len(set(problem_id[i:i+g]))!=1: raise ValueError("Unexpected group ordering")
        phase="train" if all(x.startswith("train-") for x in problem_id) else "validation"
        diag=dict(callback_index=callback_index,phase=phase,reward_mean=statistics.mean(rewards),
            reward_std=statistics.pstdev(rewards),group_variance_rate=statistics.mean(float(len(set(x))>1) for x in grouped),
            valid_rate=statistics.mean(float(r["valid"]) for r in results),
            solve_rate=statistics.mean(float(r["valid"] and r["target_ok"]) for r in results),
            entropy=None,entropy_note="not instrumented; do not substitute KL")
        with (out/"reward-diagnostics.jsonl").open("a",encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(diag)+"\n")
        with (out/"reward-outputs.jsonl").open("a",encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for pid,text,result,reward in zip(problem_id,texts,results,rewards):
                f.write(json.dumps(dict(callback_index=callback_index,phase=phase,problem_id=pid,
                    output=text,verifier=result,reward=reward),ensure_ascii=False)+"\n")
        callback_index+=1
        return rewards
    args=GRPOConfig(**training_args(c),num_generations=g,beta=c["beta"],temperature=c["temperature"],
        max_prompt_length=c["max_prompt_length"],max_completion_length=c["max_completion_length"],
        use_vllm=False,remove_unused_columns=False)
    trainer=AuditedGRPOTrainer(model=model,args=args,processing_class=tok,reward_funcs=countdown_reward,
        train_dataset=dataset(train),eval_dataset=dataset(val))
    torch.cuda.reset_peak_memory_stats();start=time.perf_counter()
    try:trainer.train()
    finally:
        torch.cuda.synchronize()
        save_run(trainer,tok,out,time.perf_counter()-start)
    print("Validation generation in trainer is diagnostic, not fixed-protocol pass@1. Use baseline.py separately.")
if __name__=="__main__":main()
